notes.title: Soccer Manager 2025: Out Now on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45219969/912532b7562f947ba38db02e301d0e27320ecef3.jpg[/img]
[h2][b] Soccer Manager 2025 is OUT NOW on Steam!
[/b][/h2]

After a few years away, we’re [b]very excited to announce that our latest instalment in the Soccer Manager series is OUT NOW on Steam![/b]

Soccer Manager 2025 has so many new & improved features that have been added since we last released a desktop version back in 2021. We heard you all loud & clear when you asked us to come back to Steam, so we’ve brought back all of the following features:

- [b]International Management[/b]
- An all new [b]3D match motion engine[/b]
- [b]Create-a-club mode[/b]
- A sleeker, more intuitive [b]UI[/b]
- [b]Manager customisation[/b]
- Fully accurate [b]continental competitions[/b]

That’s not everything - there are also hundreds of minor improvements across the board that have made SM25 [b]feel [/b]& [b]perform so much better[/b] whilst you’re playing it. 
We’re incredibly excited about our return to Steam, so make sure you [b]download the game through the page below.[/b]


[h3][b]DOWNLOAD HERE
[/b][/h3]
Play Soccer Manager 2025 NOW by clicking the link below.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3217240/Soccer_Manager_2025/
